R1.description: workflow_retention.py prune <work-item-id>... (dry run by default, --apply removes, --ttl-days as the report): each named archive must be a current archives entry of a fresh report with prunable true; the refusal order of D-Selection (invalid_id, path_unsafe, the report's refusals, the destination checks, not_in_report, removal_interrupted, not_prunable, archive_changed, archive_busy) judges the whole run before the first unlink, so one bad name removes nothing; shared checks are extracted, not copied

R2.description: Deletion: only <id>.tar.zst in the per-repository directory, one unlink through the directory descriptor after an lstat immediately before (regular, not a symlink, same size and mtime as seen), fsync of the directory each time; a failure stops the run, leaves the rest as they were and names removed and not removed; the index is never opened; an archive under the report's interrupted removals, also re-read under the lock, is never pruned; the dry run writes nothing
